lines: Your app forgot everything. Users, content, all gone. It needs a memory.
A database stores the things your product cannot lose: users, content, and state.
Think of it like a smart table. Ask for user forty two, and the database returns one exact row.
For a prototype, SQLite works. Firebase is fast. But our pick is Supabase: PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, and APIs in one place.
A database is product memory. Follow for the next guide on Auth and APIs.
Because without a database, your app forgets everything.
